title: France probes petrol bomb attacks on security forces as attempted murder

blocks.text: PARIS, France — France on Sunday opened an attempted murder investigation after petrol bombs were thrown at security forces during protests in Paris, as footage showing an officer engulfed in flames sparked outrage. On Saturday, clashes erupted in Paris and other cities after hundreds of thousands of people staged a third consecutive weekend of protests
